title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities
content:
##### SEVERITY AND IMPACT:
- Successful exploitation allows attackers to cause denial-of-service conditions, destabilize system processes, or expose sensitive authentication data.
- **Current exploitation status**: UNKNOWN

##### AFFECTED PRODUCTS:
- Citrix NetScaler ADC
- Citrix NetScaler Gateway
- Citrix Secure Private Access (hybrid environments)
- For specific versions, please check the references.

##### VULNERABILITY DETAILS:
- **Prerequisites:** Network access to the target instance, with specific features such as Gateway mode, AAA Virtual Server, or DNS-over-HTTPS load balancing enabled for certain flaws.
- **Available Mitigations:**
    - Vendor patches available

##### CVEs IN THIS ADVISORY:
- CVE-2026-120868 (CRITICAL) - Packet processing memory flaw causing unpredictable behavior or denial of service in default configurations
- CVE-2026-107407 (CRITICAL) - Denial of service via Memory overflow in SMPP traffic
- CVE-2026-107408 (CRITICAL) - Denial of service via DNS load balancing with recursive DNS resolution
- CVE-2026-107409 (CRITICAL) - Denial of service via DNS load balancing with DNS-over-HTTPS
- CVE-2026-107410 (CRITICAL) - Denial of service via NetScaler Push
- CVE-2026-107412 CVSS: 9.5 (CRITICAL) - Flaw affecting NetScaler configured as a Gateway or AAA Virtual Server

##### REFERENCES:
Primary:
- Source Advisory: https://support.citrix.com/support-home/kbsearch/article?articleNumber=CTX697305&articleTitle=Citrix_NetScaler_ADC_and_Citrix_NetScaler_Gateway_Security_Bulletin

Supporting:
- News Coverage: https://www.heise.de/news/Angreifer-koennen-Citrix-NetScaler-ADC-und-NetScaler-Gateway-lahmlegen-11522940.html

*Timestamp of the Information: 12.11.2026, 16:50*
summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, which could allow attackers to cause unpredictable system behavior, trigger denial-of-service conditions, or access sensitive information. Several flaws are classified as critical and impact instances under default configurations as well as specialized deployments such as Gateway or AAA virtual servers. Citrix has released security updates to address the vulnerabilities across all affected product lines and hybrid architectures.
